title: Browser Event Hub normalized event
description: Proposed stable event envelope emitted by the browser hook layer. This is an application contract, not a payload copied from ChatGPT's wire protocol.

eventId.description: Unique identifier assigned by the event hub.

sequence.description: Monotonic sequence assigned within one event hub instance.

requestId.description: Optional identifier used to correlate events from one HTTP request or stream.

correlationId.description: Optional identifier linking related requests when evidence supports the relationship.

payload.description: Normalized, allowlisted payload. Keep raw credentials and sensitive values out of this envelope.
